name: WayriCAD Signal Integrity Advisor
description: Calculate I2C pull-up ranges and validate routed single-ended or differential impedance.
description_full: Guided, read-only engineering checks for I2C pull-up resistance, routed impedance, differential skew, stackup/reference-layer use, vias, layer changes, zones, and unresolved topology. Includes editable protocol presets for CAN, Ethernet, RF, RS-485, SerDes, USB 2/3/4, and custom constraints.
